payout_quote: Referrer Reward: Referrer is eligible to receive a $50 Reward for each Referred Individual who completes all Qualifying Activities during the Promotional Period.
steps: Register for the Simmons Bank Refer-A-Friend Program via simmonsbank.com/refer (name + email) — referrers must be US citizens or Resident Aliens, 18+, and bank employees/households are excluded.
Share your personal referral link with friends/family via email, text, or social media (social/text posts must include the Required Disclosure that both parties may earn a reward).
The friend registers using your referral link and, within 90 days, opens a qualifying Simmons account as primary accountholder (subject to approval).

For consumer checking (Smart, Signature, Signature Plus): friend must have at least 7 debit card transactions (excluding ATM/cash) post within 30 days of opening AND at least one ACH of $100+ within 60 days. For qualifying business checking: at least 10 transactions AND $2,000+ in cumulative deposits within 60 days of opening.
After the friend completes all Qualifying Activities, you receive a $50 virtual Visa Reward Card by email within 3 weeks — paid only if the friend used your referral link to register.
catches: Cap: $500 per calendar year in Rewards whether acting as referrer, referred, or both; no partial rewards.
Reward is a virtual Visa Reward Card (not cash), delivered to your registered email within 3 weeks after qualifying activities complete; expires 6 months after issuance.
Only one referrer is paid per referred individual (first referral registration wins); you won't be told about accounts your referrals open.
Friend must complete the Qualifying Activities — see the official terms for the exact activity list.
biggest_catch: Payout is a virtual Visa Reward Card that expires 6 months after issuance, not cash — and you're capped at $500/year total (referrer + referred combined).
eligibility: Referrer and referrals must be US citizens or Resident Aliens and at least 18 years of age; Simmons Bank and subsidiary employees and members of their household are excluded. Referrals must be new customers opening a qualifying Simmons account.
timing: Registration + sharing takes ~10 minutes active; qualifying activities can take up to 90 days; $50 virtual card arrives by email within 3 weeks after the referral completes qualifying activities.
